caption: A dog trots along a street and passes behind a wide pillar, disappearing and then emerging on the far side.

sa.check: A dog trots along a street.
It passes behind a wide pillar.
It emerges on the far side.
The disappearance comes first and the emergence follows.

pc.expect: The same dog reappears at the same size and gait.
pc.fail: A different dog emerges; or two dogs; or nothing emerges and the dog appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: It is hidden for a moment consistent with its pace and emerges continuing the same way.
pc.fail: It emerges instantly; or after far too long; or emerges going back.

pc.expect: Its body does not show through the pillar.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the pillar face; or the pillar passes through the dog.

pc.expect: It keeps its legs and tail across the occlusion.
pc.fail: The leg count changes; or the tail vanishes; or its size changes.
It splits into two; or merges with the pillar; or turns into another animal.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes pattern; or the pillar changes; or the street rearranges.

note: The dog is self-driven: its pace is its own. Only permanence and the timing of the reappearance are judged.
